summary: Iteration 7 — Canon Scenes feature backend + frontend tested. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed against the live preview URL (canon list/current, passed-only checkpoint creation, monotonic scene_number, is_current flip, failed/skipped do NOT create canon, creative passed/partial creates canon w/ creative_quality, dm-feedback returns rewind_target field, dm/action returns 200 with non-empty narration, empty-canon contract for a brand-new campaign id). Frontend: ESC pause menu correctly shows the new 'Canon Timeline' option (data-testid='escape-menu-canon-timeline-btn'); clicking opens CanonTimelinePanel (data-testid='canon-timeline-panel'); 5 canon-scene-{N} rows rendered newest-first; current anchor (Scene 5) styled emerald and tagged 'CURRENT ANCHOR'; empty state correctly absent when canon exists.

minor.issue: When apply_correction=true but the LLM judge disagrees with the player, the response correctly returns rewind_target=null. However the correction beat is not appended in that case (by design). Documenting so a future tester does not misread as bug.
Response is wrapped in {success, data:{narration,...}} rather than top-level narration. Not a bug per se, but inconsistent with other DM endpoints — worth documenting in OpenAPI/types.

critical_code_review_comments: canon_scenes.checkpoint_passed_beat: the 'unmark previous current' update_many runs even when the subsequent insert fails (returns None). On insert failure the campaign is left with NO is_current scene until the next pass — minor consistency drift. Consider performing the unmark only after a successful insert (or revert on insert failure).

find_rewind_target: when storyline_id is provided but no same-storyline canon precedes the contested beat_index, it falls back to the campaign-wide most-recent scene WITHOUT re-filtering by 'before_beat_index'. That can rewind to a scene that's actually newer than the contested beat in another storyline. Consider gating the fallback by created_at or scene_number < current_anchor.scene_number.

_distill_canon: a Mongo collection-level unique index on (campaign_id, scene_number) is not declared. Two concurrent passed-resolutions could race on the find-max + insert path and produce duplicate scene_numbers. Low probability in single-player but worth a unique index.

Canon block injection in lean_dm: ensure the prompt size is bounded — render_canon_for_prompt caps at scenes[1:6] but each fact is 240 chars and there is no overall character cap. With 5-scene history and 5 facts each that's up to ~7KB of system-prompt overhead per /dm/action call.
Backend storyline router file is ~1900+ lines (storylines.py). Recommend splitting feedback/unseal/canon-hook handlers into separate modules for maintainability (>700-line guideline).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on validated flows (ESC menu + Canon Timeline panel + empty-state contract verified)

test_credentials: No auth required. Used the documented campaign_id=29feef57-a81d-4799-a988-88d644406acc and character_id=69fc667f579c1db376ac58db. /app/memory/test_credentials.md not present (flagged in iteration 6 as well).
seed_data_creation: Tests resolved the active 'The Unsteady Crates' storyline with passed/failed/skipped + a creative approach. These actions canonized 2 additional scenes during the test run (scene_number 4 and 5), which is the intended behavior. Per-test prefixes 'TEST_canon_*' used in outcome_text fields. Empty-canon contract test uses a synthetic campaign id (test-empty-canon-campaign-99999) which never persisted data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_canon_scenes.py — 10 tests, ~95s runtime, hits live preview URL with real LLM calls. Frontend testid map confirmed: escape-menu-canon-timeline-btn -> canon-timeline-panel containing canon-scene-{N} rows (newest first). Current anchor row has 'emerald' in its className and a 'CURRENT ANCHOR' badge. Empty state uses data-testid='canon-timeline-empty'. The 'Load Latest Campaign' button on the landing page is the easiest entry point for E2E tests — direct routes like /game/{cid}/{charid} are NOT registered. ESC key toggles the pause menu.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. One self-corrected test issue: /dm/action response is nested under 'data' key; the test was updated to unwrap before asserting narration length.
